ana: Quick broadcast: Private 2.5 pilot opens next week. Focus: FedRAMP-readiness docs, FIPS KMS support, and an air-gapped installer. Pilot slots limited. Please read and flag if you need seats.

sam: Security notes: optional FIPS crypto path enabled; customers can supply FIPS KMS or use our HSM partner. Airgap installer available; manual key rotation for air-gapped installs.

jia: Pilot timeline: signup opens Mon 09:00 PT, 2-week pilot, GA target 2026-04-30. Signup: https://confluence.redwood/internal/private/pilot-signup (internal).

laura: Legal: we'll draft safe contract language clarifying "FedRAMP-ready" vs "authorized". Compliance artifacts staged in the drive.

deploy-bot: "created: private-2.5-pilot-checklist by jia at 2026-03-26T12:00Z"

ana (ops): canary plan: 10% -> 40% -> full; oncall @oliver primary, @jia backup. Runbook at /runbooks/private-2.5-canary.md

ana: Note: legacy non-VPC appliance deprecated in 6 months. Migration tools will be provided.

ana: Internal walkthrough next Wed 10:00 PT. Invite soon. React :eyes: if not in pilot and want recording.
